findings.detail: The initial clock GET/status check/JSON parsing occur before the CostSourceCaptureError handler. A 503 clock response or malformed clock JSON therefore escapes as a bare exception and never reaches immutable failed-capture publication, discarding received raw evidence on this new transport boundary. Reproduced a clock503 with a bounded raw JSON body: no files were created and the exception had no captures.
findings.requested_fix: Capture and persist the clock response on both success and failure, including its status/times/raw and a deterministic source identity; attach it to collection failures and reject malformed clocks after preserving evidence. Keep all routes GET-only and files immutable.
findings.title: Persist the initial clock failure before raising

findings.detail: The raw transport decodes with strict UTF-8 before returning its evidence envelope. A non-UTF8 error body, or a multibyte sequence cut by the byte bound, raises UnicodeDecodeError before status/timestamps/raw are returned. The collector can then record only COST_SOURCE_GET_EXCEPTION with no failing-response bytes. This contradicts the new surface's purpose of retaining unsuccessful HTTP evidence. Reproduced a503 bounded response containing invalid UTF8; caller receives no HTTP evidence.
findings.requested_fix: Preserve the bounded original byte payload losslessly (with length/hash/truncation and decode status), then fail closed on invalid text without losing status/timestamps or the bytes. Do not silently replacement-decode and call that exact raw evidence.
findings.title: Do not discard bounded HTTP bytes when UTF-8 decoding fails

limitations: Fake opener and in-memory callback only; no actual transport/network/deployment verification.
Review did not revisit collector/day/producer financial semantics or prior fixes.
scope: NEW DynamicLiveClient.cost_get and capture_and_produce_cost_sources only; no re-review of collector/day/owned-producer fixes.
security_observations: Exact LIVE origin and three GET routes only; activity query keys restricted and URL encoded.
Existing NoRedirect and disabled proxies retained; no arbitrary hostname or monetary route permitted.
No write permit creation or consumption in cost_get.
Successful artifacts use dedicated runtime directories and atomic no-overwrite publication; no unsafe overwrite reproduced.
Stored captures contain response bodies and request route/query, not credential headers.
